summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Brookfield Corporation solely to confirm the record and meeting dates for its upcoming Annual and Special Meeting of Security Holders on July 16, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, no business combination, no material corporate action, and makes no mention of any event triggering a special-situation classification. It is a routine administrative notice of meeting and record dates with no substantive financial or strategic content. Accordingly, the filing is classified as None.
